Perfect! All tests pass. The issue was in the digit grouping logic on line 24. The condition `while len(head) > 3:` should have been `while len(head) > 2:`. 

In the Indian numbering system, the rightmost group has 3 digits (ones, tens, hundreds), but all other groups must have exactly 2 digits (representing lakhs, crores, etc.). By changing the condition to `> 2`, the algorithm now correctly extracts 2-digit pairs from the remaining digits, ensuring proper formatting like "₹1,23,456.78" instead of "₹123,456.78".

**The tests pass successfully.**
